method: Actual rendered DOM clicks/input events; no direct engine actions. Snapshot timed out; no visual certification. Some routine sequences scripted with waits for explicitly named DOM buttons.

setupAndTacticalNotes.details: Lobby guide link; selected Vantage, Vic central pressure vs Built to Last defensive economy; guide-only edit blocked. Builder basics external. -1 Marjanah +1 Docklands Pass, 45 cards 13/15 influence. Saved Suite Beginner 19Nov, reopened Tune deck and verified quantities.
Kept Sure Gamble, Marjanah and two run events: early economy plus barrier breaker and central pressure.
Tithe is sentry: Marjanah wrong type. Read visible subs: 1 net damage, gain 1 credit. Deliberately accept 1 net with 2-card grip; last click reserved to draw. No advanced remote yet.
Remote 1 public root 2 advancement: prioritize contesting it. Drew first to increase damage buffer, then run remote with 6 credits and Marjanah.

Contested new 2-advanced remote using Overclock; outer Lionsmane rezzed. No killer. Read subs: unavoidable 2 net, pay3 to prevent2, final jack out or2. With grip3 planned take2/pay3/jack out. Strategy limitation: ran unknown outer sentry with insufficient killer coverage; survival prioritized once revealed.
Corp scored Offworld Office 2 points. Mutual Favor fetched Carmen to solve revealed sentry problem, installed; cashed Telework and drew. Kept Tailgate for central pressure once killer usable.

1-advanced remote worth contesting before next score. With11 credits full rig and4 grip: Reverb5 + Lionsmane5 + break Tithe damage1 affordable exactly. Revealed Reverb ETR twice. Paid full breaks to protect grip. Cleaver drawn would make future barriers cheaper.
No remote root; after expensive steal economy empty. Read Borrowed Goods: MU/tag only, not income. Four credit clicks to rebuild5. Intentional recovery turn, not arbitrary pass.
Remote again2 advanced behind4 ice. Only5 credits, known Reverb5+Lionsmane5+Tithe1 already exceeds budget; cannot contest. Choose card draw engine and economy search rather than knowingly fail a run.

Orbital scored Corp5 grants tag. Used Vic draw/remove1tag for1credit; cashed finalTelework. With both at5, Jailbreak HQ again through known cheap Reverb1/Tithe damage1 instead of empty remote. Guide taught tag management goal; game UI supplied exact Vic action.

4-advanced remote likely scoring threat and Corp5. Budget4 too low for full break. Drew with Plasticity (damage buffer), gainedcredit, usedTreadLightly hoping to deny unknown outer rez. Plan preserve enough grip through Lionsmane by breaking damage strategically; this is risky desperation after economic overextension, a strategy confound.
